service_name.description: Service name (executable name) of the agent

project_name.description: Project/OS service name (used for paths and user/group)

system_user.description: System user under which the daemon runs

system_group.description: System group for the daemon user

config_file.description: Path to the main configuration file

log_file.description: Path to the log file (if USE_LOGFILE is not 'no')

pid_file_dir.description: Directory for PID file (project-specific subdirectory is already hardcoded)

use_syslog.description: Whether to use syslog instead of a log file

use_logfile.description: Set to 'no' to disable logfile (default: empty = enable logfile)

uwsgi_port.description: Port for uWSGI HTTP/HTTPS socket (if using uWSGI)

uwsgi_bind_ip.description: IP address for uWSGI socket binding (if using uWSGI)

uwsgi_ini_path.description: Path to the uWSGI INI config file (if using uWSGI)

uwsgi_ini_app.description: Path to the uWSGI app-specific INI file (if using uWSGI)

uwsgi_processes.description: Number of uWSGI worker processes (if not specified in config)
